**Update 2026-10-16.** Verifies **local** eQTLs (any variant of the gene's LD clump within
25 kb of the gene; gene-based CNVs: the CNV's gene start) from the Step1 tables, which now use per-gene LD
clumping (r2 > 0.6 within 50 kb; PLINK 1.9 `--clump` run per gene since 2026-10-21). Previously the cis-eQTLs (lead variant within 2 kb) were
verified. Output files are named `PanelB_verify_<type>_local.csv`.

# 1. Configuration

Inputs are read from `RES`; new outputs (verification CSVs, plots) are written to `OUT`.
Each variant type points to its own PLINK genotype matrix. The eQTL annotations come
from the single combined file (split by `Genetic_variants`); to use per-type files
instead, set `annot` per entry and set `USE_COMBINED <- FALSE`.


# 2. Load the single-cell object (once)

```{r load-seurat}
seurat_object <- readRDS(SEURAT_FILE)
# integrated objects store counts per replicate (counts.1, counts.2): join them
if (!"counts" %in% Layers(seurat_object[["RNA"]]))
  seurat_object[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat_object[["RNA"]])
cat("Seurat object:", ncol(seurat_object), "cells,", nrow(seurat_object), "genes\n")

# combined annotation, split by variant type; keep LOCAL eQTLs only
if (!USE_COMBINED) {
  all_annot <- lapply(names(variant_cfg), function(vt) {
    cat("Loading", vt, "annotations...\n")
    fread(variant_cfg[[vt]]$annot)
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  cat("Combined annotation rows:", nrow(all_annot), "\n")
  print(all_annot[, .N, by = .(Genetic_variants, local_distant)])
}
```

# 3. Helper functions

Column auto-detection makes the verifier work regardless of whether the gene column
is `Pheno` (combined schema) or `Source_Phenotype` (per-type schema).

```{r detectors}
detect_snp_column <- function(data) {
  for (col in c("SNP", "SNP_ID", "snp_id", "snp", "variant_id", "variant", "rsid"))
    if (col %in% colnames(data)) { cat("SNP column:", col, "\n"); return(col) }
  stop("No SNP column. Have: ", paste(colnames(data), collapse = ", "))
}
detect_gene_column <- function(data) {
  for (col in c("Pheno", "Source_Phenotype", "Gene", "gene", "gene_id", "Gene_ID", "target_gene"))
    if (col %in% colnames(data)) { cat("Gene column:", col, "\n"); return(col) }
  stop("No gene column. Have: ", paste(colnames(data), collapse = ", "))
}
detect_gene_common_name_column <- function(data) {
  for (col in c("gene_common_name", "Gene_Common_Name", "gene_name", "common_name", "symbol", "gene_symbol"))
    if (col %in% colnames(data)) { cat("Gene common-name column:", col, "\n"); return(col) }
  NULL
}
```

# What the verification tests are

Each local eQTL from FastLMM (fitted on per-strain pseudobulk expression) is checked
against the raw single-cell counts of the same gene:

1. **Cell-level NB GLM** (`Verification_Beta`, `Verification_P`): raw UMI counts of every
   cell ~ genotype (negative binomial). All cells are treated as independent, so with
   ~16,000 cells almost every test gives P < 0.05, and strains with many cells dominate
   the fit. It is used only to check the direction of effect against FastLMM.

<!-- Strain-level test removed (2026-10-21): strain means ~ genotype is essentially the
     same pseudobulk as the FastLMM input, so it is not an independent check.
2. **Strain-level test** (`Strain_Beta`, `Strain_P`): per strain, mean depth-normalised
   expression (UMI per 10,000 UMI in the cell), log2(x + 1), regressed on genotype
   across strains. The strain is the biological replicate, as in the FastLMM pseudobulk.
   An eQTL **passes verification** when the strain-level effect has the same sign as the
   FastLMM effect and `Strain_P < ALPHA` (`Strain_Pass`).
-->

`Status` records whether an eQTL could be tested: "Gene not found" (gene not in the
Seurat object under its ORF ID, ORF ID with "-", or common name), "SNP not found",
"Insufficient data" or "Model failed" (NB GLM did not fit). "Success" only means the
NB GLM fitted; it says nothing about whether the eQTL is real.

```{r data-helpers}
# Gene ID in the Seurat object: the ORF ID as given, the ORF ID with "-" instead of "."
# (pheno IDs use "." where gene IDs use "-", e.g. YBL029C.A), or the common name
resolve_gene <- function(gene_id, gene_common, seurat_genes) {
  for (g in c(gene_id, gsub(".", "-", gene_id, fixed = TRUE), gene_common))
    if (!is.na(g) && g != "" && g %in% seurat_genes) return(g)
  NULL
}

# One row per cell of a genotyped strain: genotype at the variant, raw UMI count of the
# gene and depth-normalised expression (UMI per 10,000 UMI in the cell)
extract_plot_data <- function(snp_id, resolved_gene, bim_data, fam_data, bed_matrix,
                              seurat_object) {
  snp_idx <- which(bim_data$snp_id == snp_id)[1]
  if (is.na(snp_idx)) return(NULL)
  cell_sample_map <- seurat_object$SNG.BEST.GUESS
  cells    <- names(cell_sample_map)[cell_sample_map %in% fam_data$iid]
  geno     <- setNames(as.numeric(bed_matrix[, snp_idx]), fam_data$iid)[cell_sample_map[cells]]
  names(geno) <- cells
  geno     <- geno[!is.na(geno)]
  counts   <- as.numeric(GetAssayData(seurat_object, layer = "counts")[resolved_gene, names(geno)])
  d <- data.frame(cell = names(geno), expression = counts,
                  norm_expr = 1e4 * counts / seurat_object$nCount_RNA[names(geno)],
                  genotype = unname(geno), sample = unname(cell_sample_map[names(geno)]))
  d[complete.cases(d), ]
}

# Strain-level tests (one value per strain; strains with >= MIN_CELLS_STRAIN cells):
#   Strain_P : log2(mean depth-normalised expression + 1) ~ genotype  [commented out:
#              essentially the FastLMM pseudobulk again; columns stay NA]
#   Zero_P   : fraction of the strain's cells with 0 UMI for the gene ~ genotype
#              (does one genotype have more cells that do not express the gene?)
#   NZ_P     : log2(mean expression of the strain's cells with UMI > 0) ~ genotype
#              (do the cells that express the gene make more of it in one genotype?)
# FracZero_* / MeanNZ_* are strain averages for the lowest and highest genotype.
strain_level_tests <- function(d) {
  st <- d %>% group_by(sample, genotype) %>%
    summarise(n_cells   = n(),
              mean_expr = mean(norm_expr),
              frac_zero = mean(expression == 0),
              n_nz      = sum(expression > 0),
              mean_nz   = if (any(expression > 0)) mean(norm_expr[expression > 0]) else NA_real_,
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_cells >= MIN_CELLS_STRAIN)
  out <- list(N_Strains = nrow(st), Strain_Beta = NA_real_, Strain_P = NA_real_,
              FracZero_Low = NA_real_, FracZero_High = NA_real_, Zero_P = NA_real_,
              MeanNZ_Low = NA_real_, MeanNZ_High = NA_real_, NZ_P = NA_real_)
  if (nrow(st) < 4 || length(unique(st$genotype)) < 2) return(out)
  slope_p <- function(y, x) {
    cf <- summary(lm(y ~ x))$coefficients
    if (nrow(cf) < 2) c(NA_real_, NA_real_) else unname(cf[2, c(1, 4)])
  }
  # overall <- slope_p(log2(st$mean_expr + 1), st$genotype)
  nz      <- st %>% filter(n_nz >= 3)
  lo <- min(st$genotype); hi <- max(st$genotype)
  # out$Strain_Beta   <- overall[1]; out$Strain_P <- overall[2]
  out$FracZero_Low  <- mean(st$frac_zero[st$genotype == lo])
  out$FracZero_High <- mean(st$frac_zero[st$genotype == hi])
  out$Zero_P        <- slope_p(st$frac_zero, st$genotype)[2]
  out$MeanNZ_Low    <- mean(st$mean_nz[st$genotype == lo], na.rm = TRUE)
  out$MeanNZ_High   <- mean(st$mean_nz[st$genotype == hi], na.rm = TRUE)
  out$NZ_P          <- if (nrow(nz) >= 4 && length(unique(nz$genotype)) >= 2)
                         slope_p(log2(nz$mean_nz), nz$genotype)[2] else NA_real_
  out
}
```

```{r verify-fn}
verify_eqtls_all <- function(fastlmm_results, seurat_object, bim_data, fam_data,
                             bed_matrix, n_eqtls = NULL, save_file = NULL) {
  snp_col  <- detect_snp_column(fastlmm_results)
  gene_col <- detect_gene_column(fastlmm_results)
  gene_common_col <- detect_gene_common_name_column(fastlmm_results)

  # Detect which effect size column exists
  if ("SnpWeight" %in% names(fastlmm_results)) {
    effect_col <- "SnpWeight"
  } else if ("abs_effect_size" %in% names(fastlmm_results)) {
    effect_col <- "abs_effect_size"
  } else {
    stop("Neither SnpWeight nor abs_effect_size column found in results!")
  }
  cat("Using effect size column:", effect_col, "\n")

  available_snps  <- intersect(fastlmm_results[[snp_col]], bim_data$snp_id)
  cat("Available variants:", length(available_snps), "of",
      length(unique(fastlmm_results[[snp_col]])), "\n")
  eqtls_to_verify <- fastlmm_results %>% filter(.data[[snp_col]] %in% available_snps)
  if (!is.null(n_eqtls)) {
    eqtls_to_verify <- eqtls_to_verify %>% arrange(PValue) %>% head(n_eqtls)
    cat("Verifying top", nrow(eqtls_to_verify), "by FastLMM P\n")
  } else {
    cat("Verifying all", nrow(eqtls_to_verify), "eQTLs\n")
  }
  n <- nrow(eqtls_to_verify)
  results <- data.frame(
    SNP_ID = character(n), Gene_ID = character(n),
    Gene_Common_Name = character(n), Resolved_Gene_ID = character(n),
    Status = character(n), N_Cells = integer(n),
    Verification_Beta = NA_real_, Verification_P = NA_real_,
    Verification_NegLog10P = NA_real_,   # -log10 P from the z statistic (exact even when P underflows to 0)
    FastLMM_Beta = numeric(n), FastLMM_P = numeric(n),
    Effect_Agreement = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # strain-level verification + zero / level columns
  strain_cols <- names(strain_level_tests(data.frame(sample = character(0), genotype = numeric(0),
                                                     expression = numeric(0), norm_expr = numeric(0))))
  results[strain_cols] <- NA_real_

  seurat_genes <- rownames(seurat_object)
  successful <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    snp_id  <- eqtls_to_verify[[snp_col]][i]
    gene_id <- eqtls_to_verify[[gene_col]][i]
    gene_common <- if (!is.null(gene_common_col)) eqtls_to_verify[[gene_common_col]][i] else ""
    results$SNP_ID[i] <- snp_id
    results$Gene_ID[i] <- gene_id
    results$Gene_Common_Name[i] <- ifelse(is.na(gene_common), "", gene_common)
    results$FastLMM_Beta[i] <- eqtls_to_verify[[effect_col]][i]
    results$FastLMM_P[i]    <- eqtls_to_verify$PValue[i]

    resolved_gene <- resolve_gene(gene_id, gene_common, seurat_genes)
    if (is.null(resolved_gene)) { results$Status[i] <- "Gene not found"; next }
    results$Resolved_Gene_ID[i] <- resolved_gene

    plot_data <- extract_plot_data(snp_id, resolved_gene, bim_data, fam_data, bed_matrix,
                                   seurat_object)
    if (is.null(plot_data)) { results$Status[i] <- "SNP not found"; next }
    if (nrow(plot_data) < 20 || length(unique(plot_data$genotype)) < 2) {
      results$Status[i] <- "Insufficient data"; next }
    results$N_Cells[i] <- nrow(plot_data)

    # strain-level verification and zero / level decomposition
    results[i, strain_cols] <- strain_level_tests(plot_data)

    # cell-level NB GLM on raw counts (reference only, see text)
    model <- tryCatch(glm.nb(expression ~ genotype, data = plot_data), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(model)) { results$Status[i] <- "Model failed"; next }
    cs <- summary(model)$coefficients
    results$Verification_Beta[i] <- cs[2, 1]
    results$Verification_P[i]    <- cs[2, 4]
    results$Verification_NegLog10P[i] <-
      -(log(2) + pnorm(abs(cs[2, 3]), lower.tail = FALSE, log.p = TRUE)) / log(10)
    results$Effect_Agreement[i]  <- sign(cs[2, 1]) == sign(results$FastLMM_Beta[i])
    results$Status[i] <- "Success"; successful <- successful + 1
  }

  # strain-level test commented out (essentially pseudobulk)
  # results <- results %>%
  #   mutate(Strain_Agreement = sign(Strain_Beta) == sign(FastLMM_Beta),
  #          Strain_Pass      = !is.na(Strain_P) & Strain_Agreement & Strain_P < ALPHA)

  cat("NB GLM fitted (Status = Success):", successful, "/", n, "\n")
  # cat("Strain-level pass (same direction as FastLMM, P <", ALPHA, "):",
  #     sum(results$Strain_Pass), "/", sum(!is.na(results$Strain_P)), "testable\n")
  if (!is.null(save_file)) write.csv(results, save_file, row.names = FALSE)
  results
}
```

```{r plot-fn}
# Genotype vs single-cell expression plot. `variant_type` sets genotype axis labels
# (REF/ALT parsed from the ID for SNPs/InDels, Ref/Alt for SVs = SV allele absent/present;
#  gene-based CNVs are coded 0 / 2 = CNV state absent / present).
create_enhanced_verification_plot <- function(plot_data, result, association, variant_type) {

  unique_genotypes <- sort(unique(plot_data$genotype))
  if (variant_type %in% c("SNPs", "InDels", "SVs")) {
    snp_parts <- strsplit(result$snp_id, "_")[[1]]
    # alleles are parsed from SNP/InDel IDs (chr_pos_REF_ALT); SVs: Ref/Alt = SV absent/present
    if (variant_type != "SVs" && length(snp_parts) >= 4) { ref_allele <- snp_parts[3]; alt_allele <- snp_parts[4] }
    else { ref_allele <- "Ref"; alt_allele <- "Alt" }
    lab3 <- c(paste0(ref_allele, "/", ref_allele),
              paste0(ref_allele, "/", alt_allele),
              paste0(alt_allele, "/", alt_allele))
    genotype_labels <- lab3[unique_genotypes + 1]
    x_title <- "Genotype"
  } else {
    # gene-based CNVs are coded 0 / 2 (CNV state absent / present)
    genotype_labels <- ifelse(unique_genotypes == 0, "CNV absent (0)",
                              paste0("CNV present (", unique_genotypes, ")"))
    x_title <- "Gene-based CNV"
  }
  plot_data$genotype_label <- factor(plot_data$genotype, levels = unique_genotypes,
                                     labels = genotype_labels)

  genotype_stats <- plot_data %>% group_by(genotype_label) %>%
    summarise(n_cells = n(), n_samples = length(unique(sample)),
              mean_expr = mean(expression), se_expr = sd(expression) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop")

  # no effect sizes on the plot: the single-cell NB beta and the FastLMM beta are on
  # different scales (direction agreement is printed in the report instead)
  shared_labs <- labs(
    title = paste0(variant_type, " eQTL: ", result$snp_id, " -> ", result$resolved_gene_id,
                   ifelse(result$resolved_gene_id != result$gene_id,
                          paste0(" (", result$gene_id, ")"), "")),
    x = x_title,
    caption = paste0("N=", nrow(plot_data), " cells from ",
                     length(unique(plot_data$sample)), " strains | red line shows genotype trend"))

  shared_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15), lineheight = 1.2),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black", margin = margin(r = 10)),
          axis.text = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85", size = 0.4),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))

  shared_x_scale <- scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
    sr <- genotype_stats[genotype_stats$genotype_label == x, ]
    if (nrow(sr) > 0) paste0(x, "\nN = ", sr$n_cells, "\n(", sr$n_samples, " strains)") else x })
  shared_fill <- scale_fill_manual(values = c("#66C2A5", "#FC8D62", "#8DA0CB"))

  if (median(plot_data$expression) == 0) {
    # zero-inflated gene: mean +/- SE bar plot
    p <- ggplot(genotype_stats, aes(genotype_label, mean_expr, fill = genotype_label)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_expr - se_expr, ymax = mean_expr + se_expr),
                    width = 0.15, size = 0.8) +
      geom_line(aes(as.numeric(genotype_label), mean_expr, group = 1),
                color = "red", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_point(aes(as.numeric(genotype_label), mean_expr),
                 color = "red", size = 3, shape = 16) +
      shared_fill + shared_labs + labs(y = "Mean expression (UMI counts)") +
      shared_theme + shared_x_scale + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2)))
  } else {
    y_upper <- max(quantile(plot_data$expression, 0.95) * 1.2, 2)
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(genotype_label, expression)) +
      geom_boxplot(aes(fill = genotype_label), width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
      stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2.5, color = "black", shape = 18) +
      geom_line(data = genotype_stats, aes(as.numeric(genotype_label), mean_expr, group = 1),
                color = "red", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_point(data = genotype_stats, aes(as.numeric(genotype_label), mean_expr),
                 color = "red", size = 3, shape = 16, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      shared_fill + shared_labs + labs(y = "Gene expression (UMI counts)") +
      shared_theme + shared_x_scale +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_upper))
  }
  p
}
```

```{r zero-fraction-fn}
# Fraction of cells with 0 UMI per genotype (bar = all cells pooled, dots = per strain).
# Shown beside the eQTL plot: an eQTL can act through on/off (dropout) rather than level.
create_zero_fraction_plot <- function(plot_data, result, variant_type) {
  unique_genotypes <- sort(unique(plot_data$genotype))
  if (variant_type %in% c("SNPs", "InDels", "SVs")) {
    snp_parts <- strsplit(result$snp_id, "_")[[1]]
    # alleles are parsed from SNP/InDel IDs (chr_pos_REF_ALT); SVs: Ref/Alt = SV absent/present
    if (variant_type != "SVs" && length(snp_parts) >= 4) { ref_allele <- snp_parts[3]; alt_allele <- snp_parts[4] }
    else { ref_allele <- "Ref"; alt_allele <- "Alt" }
    lab3 <- c(paste0(ref_allele, "/", ref_allele),
              paste0(ref_allele, "/", alt_allele),
              paste0(alt_allele, "/", alt_allele))
    genotype_labels <- lab3[unique_genotypes + 1]
    x_title <- "Genotype"
  } else {
    genotype_labels <- ifelse(unique_genotypes == 0, "CNV absent (0)",
                              paste0("CNV present (", unique_genotypes, ")"))
    x_title <- "Gene-based CNV"
  }
  plot_data$genotype_label <- factor(plot_data$genotype, levels = unique_genotypes,
                                     labels = genotype_labels)

  zero_stats <- plot_data %>% group_by(genotype_label) %>%
    summarise(n_cells = n(), n_zero = sum(expression == 0),
              frac_zero = n_zero / n_cells, .groups = "drop")
  strain_zero <- plot_data %>% group_by(genotype_label, sample) %>%
    summarise(frac_zero = mean(expression == 0), .groups = "drop")
  # place the % label above the highest strain dot so it is not hidden
  zero_stats <- zero_stats %>%
    left_join(strain_zero %>% group_by(genotype_label) %>%
                summarise(label_y = max(frac_zero), .groups = "drop"), by = "genotype_label") %>%
    mutate(label_y = pmax(frac_zero, label_y) + 0.02)

  ggplot(zero_stats, aes(genotype_label, frac_zero, fill = genotype_label)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(data = strain_zero, aes(genotype_label, frac_zero),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(y = label_y, label = paste0(round(100 * frac_zero, 1), "%\n(", n_zero, "/", n_cells, ")")),
              vjust = 0, size = 3.5, lineheight = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#66C2A5", "#FC8D62", "#8DA0CB")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.15), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                       labels = function(x) paste0(100 * x, "%")) +
    labs(title = "Cells with 0 UMI", x = x_title, y = "Fraction of cells with 0 UMI",
         caption = "bar = all cells | dots = individual strains") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
```

```{r raw-cell-violin-fn}
# Violin + jittered raw cells per genotype (every cell shown, no summarising).
create_raw_single_cell_plot <- function(plot_data, result, association, variant_type) {
  unique_genotypes <- sort(unique(plot_data$genotype))
  if (variant_type %in% c("SNPs", "InDels", "SVs")) {
    snp_parts <- strsplit(result$snp_id, "_")[[1]]
    # alleles are parsed from SNP/InDel IDs (chr_pos_REF_ALT); SVs: Ref/Alt = SV absent/present
    if (variant_type != "SVs" && length(snp_parts) >= 4) { ref_allele <- snp_parts[3]; alt_allele <- snp_parts[4] }
    else { ref_allele <- "Ref"; alt_allele <- "Alt" }
    lab3 <- c(paste0(ref_allele, "/", ref_allele),
              paste0(ref_allele, "/", alt_allele),
              paste0(alt_allele, "/", alt_allele))
    genotype_labels <- lab3[unique_genotypes + 1]
    x_title <- "Genotype"
  } else {
    genotype_labels <- ifelse(unique_genotypes == 0, "CNV absent (0)",
                              paste0("CNV present (", unique_genotypes, ")"))
    x_title <- "Gene-based CNV"
  }
  plot_data$genotype_label <- factor(plot_data$genotype, levels = unique_genotypes,
                                     labels = genotype_labels)
  genotype_stats <- plot_data %>% group_by(genotype_label) %>%
    summarise(n_cells = n(), n_samples = length(unique(sample)),
              mean_expr = mean(expression), .groups = "drop")
  x_labels <- setNames(paste0(genotype_stats$genotype_label, "\nN = ", genotype_stats$n_cells,
                              "\n(", genotype_stats$n_samples, " strains)"),
                       genotype_stats$genotype_label)

  y_upper <- max(quantile(plot_data$expression, 0.99) * 1.1, 2)

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(genotype_label, expression)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = genotype_label), alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0.15, size = 0.4, alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(data = genotype_stats, aes(as.numeric(genotype_label), mean_expr, group = 1),
              color = "red", linewidth = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = genotype_stats, aes(as.numeric(genotype_label), mean_expr),
               color = "red", size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#66C2A5", "#FC8D62", "#8DA0CB")) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_upper)) +
    labs(title = paste0(variant_type, " eQTL (raw cells): ", result$snp_id, " -> ",
                        result$resolved_gene_id),
         x = x_title, y = "Gene expression (UMI counts per cell)",
         caption = paste0("N=", nrow(plot_data), " cells from ",
                          length(unique(plot_data$sample)),
                          " strains | points = single cells, red = genotype mean")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
```

```{r raw-cell-plot-fn}
# Plot and save violin plots for top verified eQTLs
plot_save_raw_single_cell <- function(results_table, variant_type, n_plots,
                                      seurat_object, bim_data, fam_data, bed_matrix,
                                      out_dir, save_plots = TRUE) {
  
  results_table$SNP_ID <- as.character(results_table$SNP_ID)
  
  # Filter for successful verifications and sort by absolute beta
  top <- results_table %>% 
    filter(Status == "Success") %>%
    mutate(Abs_Beta = abs(Verification_Beta)) %>%
    arrange(desc(Abs_Beta)) %>% 
    head(n_plots)
  
  cat("Creating violin plots for top", nrow(top), variant_type, "local eQTLs by |verified beta|\n\n")
  
  if (nrow(top) == 0) {
    cat("No successful verifications found\n")
    return(list())
  }
  
  cell_sample_map      <- seurat_object$SNG.BEST.GUESS
  cells_with_genotypes <- names(cell_sample_map)[cell_sample_map %in% fam_data$iid]
  
  plots_list <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(top))) {
    row <- top[i, ]
    snp_id        <- as.character(row$SNP_ID)
    gene_id       <- as.character(row$Gene_ID)
    resolved_gene <- as.character(row$Resolved_Gene_ID)
    
    # Get genotypes for this SNP
    snp_idx <- which(bim_data$snp_id == snp_id)[1]
    if (is.na(snp_idx)) { 
      cat(sprintf("  [%d/%d] Skip %s (not in bim)\n", i, nrow(top), snp_id))
      next 
    }
    
    genotypes        <- bed_matrix[, snp_idx]
    plink_sample_map <- setNames(genotypes, fam_data$iid)
    cell_genotypes   <- plink_sample_map[cell_sample_map[cells_with_genotypes]]
    names(cell_genotypes) <- cells_with_genotypes
    cell_genotypes   <- cell_genotypes[!is.na(cell_genotypes)]
    
    # Get expression
    gene_expr <- GetAssayData(seurat_object, layer = "counts")[resolved_gene, names(cell_genotypes)]
    
    # Build plot data
    plot_data <- data.frame(
      cell = names(cell_genotypes),
      expression = as.numeric(gene_expr),
      genotype = cell_genotypes,
      sample = cell_sample_map[names(cell_genotypes)]
    )
    plot_data <- plot_data[complete.cases(plot_data), ]
    
    # Create result object
    result <- list(
      snp_id = snp_id, 
      gene_id = gene_id, 
      resolved_gene_id = resolved_gene,
      verification_beta = row$Verification_Beta,
      verification_pval = row$Verification_P
    )
    
    # Create association object
    association <- data.frame(
      SnpWeight = row$FastLMM_Beta, 
      PValue = row$FastLMM_P
    )
    
    # Create violin plot
    p <- create_raw_single_cell_plot(plot_data, result, association, variant_type)
    plots_list[[i]] <- p
    
    cat(sprintf("  [%d/%d] %s → %s\n", i, nrow(top), snp_id, resolved_gene))
    print(p)
    
    # Save plot
    if (save_plots) {
      # Sanitize filenames (remove special characters)
      snp_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", snp_id)
      gene_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", resolved_gene)
      
      fn <- file.path(out_dir, 
                      sprintf("violin_%s_top%02d_%s_%s.tiff", 
                              variant_type, i, snp_clean, gene_clean))
      
      ggsave(fn, p, width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300,
             compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
      
      cat(sprintf("      → Saved to: %s\n", basename(fn)))
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n✓ Created and saved", length(plots_list), "violin plots\n\n")
  invisible(plots_list)
}
```




```{r topn-fn}
# eQTLs to show as examples: tested eQTLs with the smallest FastLMM P
# (was: strain-level passes first, then by strain-level P; strain-level test commented out)
select_top <- function(results_table, n_plots) {
  # results_table %>% filter(!is.na(Strain_P)) %>%
  #   arrange(desc(Strain_Pass), Strain_P) %>% head(n_plots)
  results_table %>% filter(Status == "Success") %>%
    arrange(FastLMM_P) %>% head(n_plots)
}

# For the top-N eQTLs: genotype vs expression plot + fraction of zero cells, side by side
plot_top_eqtls <- function(results_table, variant_type, n_plots,
                           seurat_object, bim_data, fam_data, bed_matrix,
                           out_dir, save_plots = TRUE) {
  top <- select_top(results_table, n_plots)
  cat("Top", nrow(top), variant_type, "local eQTLs (by FastLMM P)\n")
  if (nrow(top) == 0) return(list())
  plots_list <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(top))) {
    row <- top[i, ]
    snp_id        <- as.character(row$SNP_ID)
    resolved_gene <- as.character(row$Resolved_Gene_ID)
    plot_data <- extract_plot_data(snp_id, resolved_gene, bim_data, fam_data, bed_matrix,
                                   seurat_object)
    if (is.null(plot_data)) { cat("skip (not in bim):", snp_id, "\n"); next }

    result <- list(snp_id = snp_id, gene_id = as.character(row$Gene_ID),
                   resolved_gene_id = resolved_gene,
                   verification_beta = row$Verification_Beta,
                   verification_pval = row$Verification_P)
    association <- data.frame(SnpWeight = row$FastLMM_Beta, PValue = row$FastLMM_P)

    cat(sprintf("\n\n**%s -> %s**: single-cell effect direction %s the pseudobulk (FastLMM) direction.\n\n",
                snp_id, resolved_gene,
                ifelse(isTRUE(row$Effect_Agreement), "agrees with", "does NOT agree with")))
    p_eqtl <- create_enhanced_verification_plot(plot_data, result, association, variant_type)
    p_zero <- create_zero_fraction_plot(plot_data, result, variant_type)
    p <- arrangeGrob(p_eqtl, p_zero, ncol = 2, widths = c(2, 1))
    plots_list[[i]] <- p
    grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(p)   # embed in the compiled HTML

    if (save_plots) {
      fn <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("PanelB_%s_top%02d_%s_%s.tiff", variant_type, i,
                       gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", snp_id),
                       gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", resolved_gene)))
      ggsave(fn, p, width = 18, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300,
             compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
    }
  }
  plots_list
}
```

# 4. Run per variant type (local eQTLs only)

Each type: load its PLINK matrix, take the local eQTLs, verify all of them (`N_VERIFY = NULL`;
the knit stops if any local eQTL is not tested) against the single-cell data, then plot the top `N_TOP`
(smallest FastLMM P). Every eQTL plot is shown next to the fraction of cells
with 0 UMI for each genotype.

```{r run-all, results='asis', fig.width=18, fig.height=8}
all_summaries <- list()
all_res       <- list()   # every tested eQTL, all types (for the zero-effect analysis)
for (vt in variant_order) {
  cat("\n\n## ", vt, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cfg <- variant_cfg[[vt]]
  bed_matrix <- BEDMatrix(cfg$plink)
  bim_data   <- fread(paste0(cfg$plink, ".bim"),
                      col.names = c("chr","snp_id","gen_dist","pos","allele1","allele2"))
  fam_data   <- fread(paste0(cfg$plink, ".fam"),
                      col.names = c("fid","iid","father","mother","sex","phenotype"))
  # SV/CNV .fam split some names (FID = SACE, IID = YCK); rebuild SACE_YCK to match the Seurat IDs
  fam_data[fid != iid, iid := paste(fid, iid, sep = "_")]

  if (USE_COMBINED) {
    ann <- all_annot[Genetic_variants == vt]
  } else {
    ann <- fread(cfg$annot)
  }
  cis <- as.data.frame(ann[ann$local_distant == "Local", ])   # local eQTLs (variable name kept)
  cat("local eQTLs:", nrow(cis), " | PLINK strains:", nrow(fam_data),
      " | variants:", nrow(bim_data), "\n\n")

  if (nrow(cis) == 0) { cat("_No local eQTLs — skipped._\n"); next }

  res <- verify_eqtls_all(cis, seurat_object, bim_data, fam_data, bed_matrix,
                          n_eqtls = N_VERIFY,
                          save_file = file.path(OUT, paste0("PanelB_verify_", vt, "_local.csv")))
  all_res[[vt]] <- res %>% mutate(Variant_type = vt)

  # every local eQTL must be tested: none dropped (variant missing from PLINK) and the NB GLM fitted for all
  untested <- res[res$Status != "Success", c("SNP_ID", "Gene_ID", "Status")]
  missing  <- setdiff(paste(cis$SNP, cis$Pheno), paste(res$SNP_ID, res$Gene_ID))
  cat("\nTested (NB GLM fitted):", sum(res$Status == "Success"), "of", nrow(cis), "local eQTLs\n\n")
  if (is.null(N_VERIFY) && (length(missing) > 0 || nrow(untested) > 0)) {
    print(untested); print(missing)
    stop(vt, ": not all local eQTLs were tested (see above)")
  }

  plot_top_eqtls(res, vt, N_TOP, seurat_object, bim_data, fam_data, bed_matrix,
                 out_dir = OUT, save_plots = TRUE)

  # ---- raw single cells (violin) + fraction of zero cells, same eQTLs ----
  cat("\n### ", vt, " - Raw Single Cells\n\n", sep = "")
  top_eqtls <- select_top(res, N_TOP)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_eqtls))) {
    row <- top_eqtls[i, ]
    snp_id        <- as.character(row$SNP_ID)
    resolved_gene <- as.character(row$Resolved_Gene_ID)
    plot_data <- extract_plot_data(snp_id, resolved_gene, bim_data, fam_data, bed_matrix,
                                   seurat_object)
    if (is.null(plot_data)) next

    result <- list(snp_id = snp_id, gene_id = as.character(row$Gene_ID),
                   resolved_gene_id = resolved_gene,
                   verification_beta = row$Verification_Beta,
                   verification_pval = row$Verification_P)
    association <- data.frame(SnpWeight = row$FastLMM_Beta, PValue = row$FastLMM_P)

    p_raw  <- create_raw_single_cell_plot(plot_data, result, association, vt)
    p_zero <- create_zero_fraction_plot(plot_data, result, vt)
    p <- arrangeGrob(p_raw, p_zero, ncol = 2, widths = c(2, 1))
    grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(p)

    fn <- file.path(OUT, sprintf("violin_%s_top%02d_%s_%s.tiff", vt, i,
                                 gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", snp_id),
                                 gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", resolved_gene)))
    ggsave(fn, p, width = 18, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300,
           compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
    cat(sprintf("    → Saved: %s\n", basename(fn)))
  }

  # tested <- res[!is.na(res$Strain_P), ]                  # strain-level test commented out
  ok     <- res[res$Status == "Success", ]
  all_summaries[[vt]] <- data.frame(
    Variant_type      = vt,
    local_eQTLs       = nrow(cis),
    gene_not_found    = sum(res$Status == "Gene not found"),
    # tested            = nrow(tested),                       # strain-level tests ran
    # strain_same_dir   = sum(tested$Strain_Agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
    # strain_pass       = sum(tested$Strain_Pass),            # same direction AND P < ALPHA
    # pct_pass          = if (nrow(tested)) round(100 * mean(tested$Strain_Pass), 1) else NA,
    # strain_beta_cor   = if (nrow(tested) > 2) round(cor(tested$Strain_Beta, tested$FastLMM_Beta), 3) else NA,
    nb_fitted         = nrow(ok),                           # cell-level NB GLM
    nb_same_dir       = if (nrow(ok)) sum(ok$Effect_Agreement, na.rm = TRUE) else 0)
}
```

# 5. Cross-type validation summary

`nb_fitted`: eQTLs for which the cell-level NB GLM fitted. `nb_same_dir`: of these, NB GLM
effect has the same sign as the FastLMM effect. (Strain-level columns commented out.)

```{r summary-table}
summary_tbl <- bind_rows(all_summaries)
knitr::kable(summary_tbl, caption = "Verification of local eQTLs against the single-cell data")
write.csv(summary_tbl, file.path(OUT, "PanelB_validation_summary_all_types.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 6. Pseudobulk vs raw single-cell eQTLs: summary

All local eQTLs detected in the pseudobulk data (FastLMM) are re-tested on raw single-cell
UMI counts with the cell-level negative-binomial GLM (counts ~ genotype, every cell one
observation). NB beta is the natural-log change in mean UMI per copy of the variant
allele (SNPs, InDels, SVs: 0/1/2) or per unit of the CNV state code (0/2); it is on a different scale from the FastLMM effect (fitted on normalised pseudobulk
expression), so the two magnitudes are not compared directly.

```{r sc-vs-pseudobulk}
sc <- bind_rows(all_res) %>%
  mutate(Variant_type = factor(Variant_type, levels = variant_order),
         NB_P_BH = p.adjust(Verification_P, method = "BH"))
fitted <- sc %>% filter(Status == "Success")

answers <- sc %>% group_by(Variant_type) %>%
  summarise(local_eQTLs_pseudobulk = n(),
            Q1_tested_single_cell  = sum(Status == "Success"),
            Q2_P_below_0.05        = sum(Verification_P < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            Q2_BH_FDR_below_0.05   = sum(NB_P_BH < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            Q3_same_direction      = sum(Effect_Agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
answers <- bind_rows(answers, answers %>% summarise(Variant_type = "All",
                                                    across(where(is.numeric), sum)))
knitr::kable(answers, caption = "Q1-Q3: pseudobulk local eQTLs re-tested on raw single-cell counts")
write.csv(answers, file.path(OUT, "PanelB_singlecell_vs_pseudobulk_answers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


show_cols <- c("Variant_type", "SNP_ID", "Resolved_Gene_ID", "Gene_Common_Name",
               "Verification_Beta", "Verification_P", "FastLMM_Beta", "Effect_Agreement")

# Q4: largest single-cell effect (|NB beta|), with direction
q4 <- fitted %>% arrange(desc(abs(Verification_Beta))) %>% head(5) %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(Verification_Beta > 0, "up with allele", "down with allele")) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(show_cols), Direction)
knitr::kable(q4, digits = 3, caption = "Q4: top 5 local eQTLs by single-cell |NB beta|")

write.csv(q4, file.path(OUT, "PanelB_top5_singlecell_effects.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 7. P-values: single cells vs pseudobulk

FastLMM tests each eQTL across strains (pseudobulk, n = strains, with the kinship matrix).
The cell-level NB GLM treats every cell as an independent observation although all cells
of a strain share one genotype, so its P-values are expected to be far smaller than the
pseudobulk P-values for the same eQTL (inflated). -log10 P of the NB GLM is computed from the z statistic, so it is
exact even when P is below the smallest number R can store (P printed as 0).

```{r pvalue-comparison, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
pv <- bind_rows(all_res) %>% filter(Status == "Success") %>%
  mutate(Variant_type        = factor(Variant_type, levels = variant_order),
         FastLMM_NegLog10P   = -log10(FastLMM_P))
         # Strain_NegLog10P    = -log10(Strain_P))   # strain-level test commented out

n_cells   <- median(pv$N_Cells)
# n_strains <- median(pv$N_Strains, na.rm = TRUE)

# how much smaller are the single-cell P-values?
pv_stats <- data.frame(
  test = c("FastLMM (pseudobulk strains)", "NB GLM (single cells)"),
  median_neglog10P = c(median(pv$FastLMM_NegLog10P), median(pv$Verification_NegLog10P)),
  min_neglog10P = c(min(pv$FastLMM_NegLog10P), min(pv$Verification_NegLog10P)),
  max_neglog10P = c(max(pv$FastLMM_NegLog10P), max(pv$Verification_NegLog10P)))
  # strain-level row commented out: "Strain means (single-cell data)", Strain_NegLog10P
knitr::kable(pv_stats, digits = 1, caption = "-log10 P per test across all tested local eQTLs")

ratio <- pv$Verification_NegLog10P / pv$FastLMM_NegLog10P
cat("Single-cell vs pseudobulk -log10 P: median ratio =", round(median(ratio), 1),
    "(range", round(min(ratio), 1), "-", round(max(ratio), 1), ");",
    sum(pv$Verification_NegLog10P > pv$FastLMM_NegLog10P), "of", nrow(pv),
    "eQTLs have a smaller P in single cells\n")
ct_p <- cor.test(pv$FastLMM_NegLog10P, pv$Verification_NegLog10P, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
cat("Spearman rho (-log10 P, FastLMM vs NB GLM) =", round(ct_p$estimate, 3),
    ", P =", signif(ct_p$p.value, 3), "\n")

# effect direction agreement for the text
# sign test: is the number of eQTLs with the same direction higher than expected if
# direction were a coin flip (50%)?
n_same <- sum(sign(pv$FastLMM_Beta) == sign(pv$Verification_Beta))
sign_test <- binom.test(n_same, nrow(pv), p = 0.5)
cat("Direction concordance:", n_same, "/", nrow(pv), "| sign test P =",
    format(sign_test$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")

effect_stats <- data.frame(
  comparison     = "Direction concordance (sign test vs 50%)",
  n              = nrow(pv),
  same_direction = n_same,
  pct_same       = 100 * n_same / nrow(pv),
  CI95_low_pct   = 100 * sign_test$conf.int[1],   # Clopper-Pearson
  CI95_high_pct  = 100 * sign_test$conf.int[2],
  P              = sign_test$p.value)
knitr::kable(effect_stats, digits = 3, caption = "Effect direction concordance")

# effect size agreement: FastLMM beta is on DESeq + inverse-normal-transformed expression
# (SD units) and NB beta is a log fold change, so only the ranks are compared (Spearman)
beta_cor <- function(d) {
  ct <- cor.test(d$FastLMM_Beta, d$Verification_Beta, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  data.frame(n = nrow(d), rho = unname(ct$estimate), P = ct$p.value)
}
beta_cor_stats <- bind_rows(
  pv %>% group_by(Variant_type) %>% group_modify(~ beta_cor(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Variant_type = as.character(Variant_type)),
  beta_cor(pv) %>% mutate(Variant_type = "All"))
knitr::kable(beta_cor_stats, digits = 3,
             caption = "Spearman correlation of effect sizes, NB GLM beta vs FastLMM beta")
cat("Spearman rho (beta, FastLMM vs NB GLM, all) =", round(beta_cor_stats$rho[beta_cor_stats$Variant_type == "All"], 3),
    ", P =", signif(beta_cor_stats$P[beta_cor_stats$Variant_type == "All"], 3), "\n")

p_beta <- ggplot(pv, aes(FastLMM_Beta, Verification_Beta, color = Variant_type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = variant_colors, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Effect size, pseudobulk FastLMM", y = "Effect size, single-cell NB GLM") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 13))
print(p_beta)
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "PanelB_beta_singlecell_vs_pseudobulk.tiff"), p_beta,
       width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")

write.csv(bind_rows(pv_stats %>% mutate(stat = "neglog10P"),
                    effect_stats %>% mutate(stat = "direction_concordance"),
                    beta_cor_stats %>% mutate(stat = "beta_spearman")),
          file.path(OUT, "PanelB_pvalue_and_effect_agreement_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# plot: each eQTL's single-cell NB P against its FastLMM P (strain-mean P commented out)
pv_long <- bind_rows(
  pv %>% transmute(Variant_type, x = FastLMM_NegLog10P, y = Verification_NegLog10P,
                   Test = sprintf("Single cells, NB GLM (n = %s cells)", format(n_cells, big.mark = ",")))) %>%
  # pv %>% transmute(Variant_type, x = FastLMM_NegLog10P, y = Strain_NegLog10P,
  #                  Test = sprintf("Strain means (n = %s strains)", format(n_strains)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(y))
p_pv <- ggplot(pv_long, aes(x, y, color = Test)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#C0392B", "#2471A3"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = expression(bold(-log[10]~"P, pseudobulk FastLMM")),
       y = expression(bold(-log[10]~"P, single-cell data"))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 13))
print(p_pv)
ggsave(file.path(OUT, "PanelB_pvalue_singlecell_vs_pseudobulk.tiff"), p_pv,
       width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
```

# 8. Top example: expressed in almost every cell, but more in one genotype

An eQTL can lower a gene's average expression in two ways: fewer cells express the gene
(more cells with 0 UMI), or the cells that do express it make less of it. This example is
an eQTL of the second kind: the fraction of cells with 0 UMI is below 50% in both genotypes
and does not differ between them (`Zero_P >= ALPHA`), while the expression of the cells
that express the gene does (`NZ_P < ALPHA`; the eQTL with the smallest `NZ_P` is shown).
Both tests compare strains (one value per strain), as described in the helper functions.

```{r top-hit, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 8}
all_tested <- bind_rows(all_res) %>% filter(!is.na(Zero_P))   # was !is.na(Strain_P)
candidates <- all_tested %>%
  filter(!(Zero_P < ALPHA) %in% TRUE,                     # same fraction of 0-UMI cells
         pmax(FracZero_Low, FracZero_High) < 0.5) %>%     # most cells express it in both
  arrange(desc(NZ_P < ALPHA), NZ_P)
knitr::kable(head(candidates %>%
                    dplyr::select(Variant_type, SNP_ID, Resolved_Gene_ID, FracZero_Low, FracZero_High,
                                  Zero_P, MeanNZ_Low, MeanNZ_High, NZ_P), 10),
             digits = 3, caption = "Candidates: same fraction of 0-UMI cells in both genotypes (ranked by NZ_P)")

if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {
  cat("No local eQTL where both genotypes mostly express the gene and the zero fraction is unchanged.\n")
} else {
  hit <- candidates[1, ]
  if (!(hit$NZ_P < ALPHA) %in% TRUE)
    cat("Note: no candidate has a significant difference in expressing cells; showing the one with the smallest NZ_P.\n")
  vt  <- as.character(hit$Variant_type)
  cfg <- variant_cfg[[vt]]
  bed_matrix <- BEDMatrix(cfg$plink)
  bim_data   <- fread(paste0(cfg$plink, ".bim"),
                      col.names = c("chr","snp_id","gen_dist","pos","allele1","allele2"))
  fam_data   <- fread(paste0(cfg$plink, ".fam"),
                      col.names = c("fid","iid","father","mother","sex","phenotype"))
  # SV/CNV .fam split some names (FID = SACE, IID = YCK); rebuild SACE_YCK to match the Seurat IDs
  fam_data[fid != iid, iid := paste(fid, iid, sep = "_")]
  plot_data <- extract_plot_data(hit$SNP_ID, hit$Resolved_Gene_ID, bim_data, fam_data,
                                 bed_matrix, seurat_object)

  # genotype labels as in the other plots
  ug <- sort(unique(plot_data$genotype))
  if (vt %in% c("SNPs", "InDels", "SVs")) {
    parts <- strsplit(hit$SNP_ID, "_")[[1]]
    ra <- if (vt != "SVs" && length(parts) >= 4) parts[3:4] else c("Ref", "Alt")
    glab <- c(paste0(ra[1], "/", ra[1]), paste0(ra[1], "/", ra[2]), paste0(ra[2], "/", ra[2]))[ug + 1]
    x_title <- "Genotype"
  } else {
    glab <- ifelse(ug == 0, "CNV absent (0)", paste0("CNV present (", ug, ")"))
    x_title <- "Gene-based CNV"
  }
  plot_data$genotype_label <- factor(plot_data$genotype, levels = ug, labels = glab)

  # expressing cells only, with one dot per strain (mean of its expressing cells)
  nz_cells  <- plot_data %>% filter(expression > 0)
  nz_strain <- nz_cells %>% group_by(genotype_label, sample) %>%
    summarise(mean_nz = mean(norm_expr), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% filter(n >= 3)
  # x-axis labels: genotype, number of expressing cells and number of strains
  x_counts <- nz_cells %>% group_by(genotype_label) %>%
    summarise(n_cells = n(), n_strains = n_distinct(sample), .groups = "drop")
  x_labels <- setNames(paste0(x_counts$genotype_label, "\nN = ", x_counts$n_cells,
                              "\n(", x_counts$n_strains, " strains)"),
                       x_counts$genotype_label)
  p_level <- ggplot(nz_cells, aes(genotype_label, norm_expr)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = genotype_label), alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
    geom_jitter(data = nz_strain, aes(genotype_label, mean_nz), width = 0.12, height = 0,
                size = 2.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    stat_summary(data = nz_strain, aes(genotype_label, mean_nz, group = 1), fun = mean,
                 geom = "line", color = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#66C2A5", "#FC8D62", "#8DA0CB")) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, quantile(nz_cells$norm_expr, 0.99))) +
    labs(title = paste0(vt, " eQTL: ", hit$SNP_ID, " -> ", hit$Resolved_Gene_ID),
         x = x_title, y = "Expression in cells with UMI > 0\n(UMI per 10,000 UMI)",
         caption = "violin = cells with UMI > 0 | dots = strain means | red = genotype mean") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = AXIS_SIZE, face = "bold", color = "black"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
  p_zero <- create_zero_fraction_plot(plot_data, list(snp_id = hit$SNP_ID), vt)
  p_hit  <- arrangeGrob(p_level, p_zero, ncol = 2, widths = c(2, 1))
  grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(p_hit)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT, sprintf("PanelB_top_hit_expressed_in_both_genotypes_%s_%s.tiff",
                                gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", hit$SNP_ID),
                                gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", hit$Resolved_Gene_ID))),
         p_hit, width = 18, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
}
```
